name: CreateProduct

parameters.help_en:
The name of the product.

The value must be 1 to 128 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
产品名称。

长度为1~128个字符

parameters.help_en:
The type of the product.

Set the value to Ros, which specifies Resource Orchestration Service (ROS)

产品类型。

取值为Ros，表示阿里云资源编排服务（ROS）

长度为1~128个字符

parameters.help_en:
The provider of the product.

The value must be 1 to 128 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
产品提供者。

长度为1~128个字符

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the product version. Valid values:

true (default)

false
fields.help_zh:
是否启用。取值：

true（默认值）：启用。
false：禁用

fields.example: This is a product version description.

fields.help_zh:

fields.name: description

fields.help_en:
The recommended product version. Valid values:

Default (default): No product version is recommended.

Recommended: the stable version.

Latest: the latest version.

Deprecated: the version that is about to be deprecated
fields.help_zh:
推荐信息。取值：

Default（默认值）：无。
Recommended：稳定版。
Latest：最新版。
Deprecated：将废弃

fields.help_en:

fields.help_zh:

fields.help_en:
The type of the template.

Set the value to RosTerraformTemplate, which indicates the Terraform template that is supported by Resource Orchestration Service (ROS)

模板类型。

取值为RosTerraformTemplate，表示阿里云资源编排服务（ROS）支持的Terraform模板
